newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE posts record turnover - dealers.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE posts record turnover - dealers.

text.p: South Africa's Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) saw a record day of turnover with more than 1.5 billion rands worth of shares changing hands, dealers said.
A JSE spokeswoman said initial figures showed turnover at 1.506 billion rands worth, but that exact data would be released shortly.
The day's trade was heavily boosted by asset swaps, notably in tobacco concern Richemont Securities Ltd, and the listing of chicken restaurant chain Nando's Group Holdings Ltd.
